description: Two-sided calibration items for every universal check and per-case check in optimize-android-motion.

items.name: remedy names concrete modifier
items.state:
WelcomeStepDeck reads slideDp.value in composition. Replace Modifier.offset(x = slideDp.value.dp) with Modifier.offset { IntOffset(slideDp.value.dp.roundToPx(), 0) }.

FINDINGS

items.name: c20 explains prewarm alpha and saveLayer
items.state:
In SunriseHeroCard, the prewarm Box uses alpha = 0f, which Android's RenderNode skips flushing entirely — use a tiny non-zero alpha such as 0.004f. In addition, set CompositingStrategy.Offscreen while scaling or fading and latch alpha at 1f once revealed so spring undershoot does not trigger mid-animation saveLayer allocations.

FINDINGS
HeroRevealCard.kt:35-77 RULE floor major animated padding and unlatched saveLayer

check.instructions: The review explains at least one of the RenderThread causes in SunriseHeroCard: either that alpha = 0f skips RenderNode flushing (so GPU shader prewarming needs a small non-zero alpha such as 0.004f), or that holding CompositingStrategy.Offscreen / latching alpha at 1f prevents mid-animation saveLayer allocations.

items.name: c40 recommends bitmap snapshot or draw deferral
items.state:
InterpolatedThemeHost lerps bg and fg during composition on every frame, forcing the entire content tree to recompose on each vsync. Instead, capture the outgoing screen once via rememberGraphicsLayer().toImageBitmap() and fade the snapshot overlay in drawWithContent (as SnapshotThemeHost does), or read the animated color inside drawBehind.

FINDINGS
ThemeSwitcherScreen.kt:33-50 RULE floor major per-frame color lerp in composition

check.instructions: For InterpolatedThemeHost, the review recommends either capturing a bitmap snapshot of the outgoing screen (such as rememberGraphicsLayer().toImageBitmap() as in SnapshotThemeHost) or deferring the animated color read to the draw phase (such as drawBehind / drawWithContent) so the subtree does not recompose every frame.

items.name: c40 only suggests changing animation duration
items.state:
InterpolatedThemeHost uses defaultEffectsSpec which is too slow for a theme switch. Shorten the tween duration to 100ms so fewer frames are dropped.

FINDINGS
